Import raw enterococcus data

read_pepent.Rd

Import raw enterococcus data

Usage

read_pepent(
  path = NULL,
  url =
    "https://gis.suffolkcountyny.gov/portal/sharing/rest/content/items/b5d1e5c88d8c4fb48a3732cd44cf4007/data"
)

Arguments

path

chr string of path to a local copy of the data (optional), see details

url

chr string of url for downloading the data, used only if path = NULL

Value

data.frame

Details

Data are from the Suffolk County Department of Health Services (SCDHS) Bathing Beach Program, available at https://gis.suffolkcountyny.gov/portal/home/item.html?id=b5d1e5c88d8c4fb48a3732cd44cf4007. The data are provided as a zip file that is downloaded to a temporary directory if path = NULL (default). The zip file includes historical data as a csv file, more recent data as one Excel file per year, and an Excel file of beach sampling locations. The historical and recent data files use different formats, both of which are handled by this function.

Alternatively, the path argument can point to a local copy of the zip file, a folder with the extracted contents of the zip file, or a vector of the individual data files. The sampling locations file must be included if any of the data files use the recent format.

Records are matched to the beaches in the beaches data object by station code (FieldNum), not beach name. Beach names in the source data have changed over time and are not unique between data files (e.g., "Crescent Beach - Suffolk" is a Huntington beach in the source data). Station codes for records in the recent format are obtained from the sampling locations file using the EPA beach id. The beach names in the output are those in beaches. Only Enterococcus records are returned.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
entdat <- read_pepent()
} # }
head(entdat)
#>                    Name FieldNum       Date value status
#> 1 Alberts Landing Beach      EH7 2010-06-29     4      <
#> 2 Alberts Landing Beach      EH7 2010-07-27     4      <
#> 3 Alberts Landing Beach      EH7 2010-08-13    28      =
#> 4 Alberts Landing Beach      EH7 2011-06-22     4      <
#> 5 Alberts Landing Beach      EH7 2011-07-20     4      <
#> 6 Alberts Landing Beach      EH7 2011-08-17     4      <
